+// One true-dual-port memory: port A performs the accumulator read/modify/write,
+// while port B serves the independent user read port.
+module hough_cell_dual_ram #(
+    parameter int N = 1536
+) (
+    input  logic        clk,
+    input  logic        wea,
+    input  logic [10:0] waddr_a,
+    input  logic [15:0] wdata_a,
+    input  logic [10:0] raddr_a,
+    output logic [15:0] rdata_a,
+    input  logic [10:0] raddr_b,
+    output logic [15:0] rdata_b
+);
+    (* ram_style = "block" *) logic [15:0] mem [0:N-1];
+
+    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
+        if (wea) mem[waddr_a] <= wdata_a;
+        rdata_a <= mem[raddr_a];
+    end
+
+    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
+        rdata_b <= mem[raddr_b];
     end
 endmodule
